name: @taffyjs/node
description: Native Node-API bindings for the Taffy layout engine.

scripts.build: napi build --manifest-path ../../crates/taffyjs_binding/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --js native.js --dts native.d.ts --esm --release && vp fmt native.js native.d.ts package.json && node ../../tools/sync-platform-artifact.mjs && vp pack && napi build --manifest-path ../../crates/taffyjs_binding/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir node_modules/.cache/taffyjs-test-hooks --platform --js test-hooks.js --dts test-hooks.d.ts --esm --release --features test-hooks
scripts.build:debug: napi build --manifest-path ../../crates/taffyjs_binding/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --js native.js --dts native.d.ts --esm && vp fmt native.js native.d.ts package.json && node ../../tools/sync-platform-artifact.mjs && vp pack
